purpose: Acquire real, machine-readable religious corpus content rather than catalog-only records.

policy.primaryGoal: materialize source content where redistribution rights are explicit
policy.copyright: Never copy a copyrighted edition merely because it is publicly viewable.
policy.derivatives: Generate search/index/HTML/JSON derivatives only from material whose source terms permit it.
policy.manuscripts: Download manuscript page images only where the digitization record explicitly states public-domain or a compatible reuse license.
policy.verification: Preserve source URL, upstream revision, retrieval time and SHA-256 for every acquired object.
